def test_paginate_malformed_numeric_text_page():
    items = list(range(100))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate(items, page='1.5', size=10)

def test_paginate_malformed_numeric_text_size():
    items = list(range(100))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate(items, page=2, size='10.5')

def test_paginate_size_1():
    items = list(range(100))
    result = paginate(items, page=1, size=1)
    assert result == {'items': [0], 'total': 100, 'pages': 100}

def test_paginate_size_100():
    items = list(range(100))
    result = paginate(items, page=1, size=100)
    assert result == {'items': list(range(100)), 'total': 100, 'pages': 1}
